description: This file is a shell script used for identifying, validating, and upgrading firmware images on a specific hardware platform (likely a router or embedded device). It contains functions to analyze firmware files based on magic numbers, headers, and device-specific identifiers, and performs compatibility checks before upgrading.

methods.name: get_magic_long_at
methods.description: Reads 4 bytes at a given offset from a file, returning the hex string.

methods.name: get_le_long_at
methods.description: Reads a little-endian 4-byte number at a given offset from a file.

methods.name: platform_expected_image
methods.description: Returns the expected device identifier string based on the device model for firmware compatibility checks.

methods.name: bcm47xx_identify
methods.description: Identifies the firmware image type (chk, cybertan, lxl, lxlold, trx, unknown) based on magic numbers.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Main function to validate a firmware image against the device, checking compatibility and firmware integrity.

methods.name: platform_trx_from_chk_cmd
methods.description: Generates a command to extract the TRX firmware from a CHK image.

methods.name: platform_trx_from_cybertan_cmd
methods.description: Generates a command to extract the TRX firmware from a CyberTAN image.

methods.name: platform_trx_from_lxl_cmd
methods.description: Generates a command to extract the TRX firmware from a Luxul (lxl) image.

methods.name: platform_trx_from_lxlold_cmd
methods.description: Generates a command to extract the TRX firmware from an old Luxul (lxlold) image.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade by identifying the firmware type and executing the appropriate extraction command.
